citation: O.C.G.A. § 53-12-25 (Transfer of property in trust — trust named as grantee deemed transfer to trustee; real-property conveyance must be recorded)
evidence: Official free per-section OCGA text is not curl-verifiable: Georgia's official code is published by the Code Revision Commission through LexisNexis (advance.lexis.com container pages return HTTP 200 but are a JS application with no statute text in curl HTML), code.ga.gov does not resolve (NXDOMAIN), sos.ga.gov returns 403 to curl, and legis.ga.gov is a React SPA. Statute text verified instead against the Internet Archive's official OCGA mirror (item gov.ga.ocga.2018, Title 53 HTML, HTTP 200, 3.6 MB): '§ 53-12-25. Transfer of property in trust shall require a transfer of legal title to the trustee. In any transfer of property or any interest in property, if a trust is named as a grantee... such transfer is deemed to have been made to the trustee of such trust... For any interest in real property to become trust property in a trust of which any transferor is a trustee, the instrument of conveyance shall additionally be recorded in the appropriate real property records.' notes: Georgia has no statute named 'land trust'; recognition basis is the Revised Georgia Trust Code of 2010, O.C.G.A. § 53-12-25 (deemed-transfer-to-trustee rule + real-property recording requirement), the provision cited by land-trust practice in GA. official_url set to null per no-fabrication rule because no official legislature URL could pass curl text-verification.
